story.title: The Applause Loop
story.logline: A lonely street performer discovers that the digital cheers echoing from his phone are literally draining the happiness from real strangers passing by.
story.theme: The hidden human cost of digital validation.
story.twist: The likes and cheers aren't coming from a social media app at all—they are being stolen in real-time from the pedestrians watching him.
story.ending: He stands in total silence, holding a phone that will never ring again, wondering if his art is worth a stranger's joy.

scenes.narration: My phone just exploded with ten thousand cheers for playing three chords on a dusty sidewalk.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, wearing a faded green hoodie, standing on a gritty subway platform, staring at a glowing smartphone screen.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Leo's face, rapid zoom out to reveal the subway station.

scenes.narration: Every time the notification bell rings, the applause gets louder, roaring straight into my headphones.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, faded green hoodie, wearing black wireless earbuds, tapping his glowing phone screen in the subway station.
scenes.camera: Medium tracking shot circling Leo as he smiles at his phone.

scenes.narration: I look up. A businesswoman walking past me suddenly stumbles, her face instantly turning completely blank and lifeless.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, faded green hoodie, looking up from his phone in the subway station as a stressed woman freezes mid-stride.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot from Leo looking at the freezing woman.

scenes.narration: Another wave of digital cheers hits my screen. The woman slumps against the tiled wall, sobbing silently.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, faded green hoodie, watching a crying woman lean against the subway tiles while checking his phone.
scenes.camera: Wide shot of the platform emphasizing the sudden heavy atmosphere.

scenes.narration: I check the app. The applause counter matches the exact second her smile vanished into thin air.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, faded green hoodie, holding his phone close to his face, showing a soaring follower count.
scenes.camera: Quick push-in on the glowing phone screen reflecting in Leo's wide eyes.

scenes.narration: I stop strumming my guitar. The digital cheers instantly stutter, choking off into heavy, static silence.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, faded green hoodie, dropping his hand from his guitar strings in the dim subway station.
scenes.camera: Low angle looking up at Leo, static and still.

scenes.narration: The weeping woman takes a deep breath, color returning to her cheeks as she looks around, confused.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, faded green hoodie, watching the same woman push herself off the wall with a faint, genuine smile.
scenes.camera: Medium shot panning slightly with the relieved woman.

scenes.narration: My screen flashes. A notification warns me: keep playing, or lose your audience forever.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, faded green hoodie, staring at a terrifying warning text prompt glowing red on his phone.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the red text reflecting in Leo's panicked eyes.

scenes.narration: I stare at my guitar, then at the crowded subway platform full of living, breathing human beings.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, faded green hoodie, looking back and forth between his guitar and oblivious commuters walking by.
scenes.camera: Rapid whip pans between Leo's face and the crowd.

scenes.narration: With trembling hands, I drop my phone onto the tracks. How loud does your applause have to be to drown out someone else's soul?
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, faded green hoodie, watching a smartphone shatter on the dark subway tracks below.
scenes.camera: High angle looking straight down at the shattered phone on the rails.

caption.hook: Every cheer he gets steals their joy.
caption.title: The Applause Loop
caption.caption: He thought his new streaming app was finally bringing him the audience he deserved. But every virtual standing ovation leaves a hollow, weeping stranger in his wake. How much fake love would you trade for real happiness?
